messages.content: Use web search to find relevant datasets. Only include landing pages or DOIs. Do not invent links. Do not call time, date, timestamp, or clock tools.

Query: Can you find datasets about Employment in North Rhine-Westphalia during the 1980s?
Respond ONLY as JSON in this exact shape: {"items":[{"title":"...","url_or_doi":"...","justification":"..."}]}. Put any DOI, URL, landing page, or link in url_or_doi.

queries: GENESIS NRW Erwerbstätige 1980 1989 historische Daten Beschäftigte
Regionaldatenbank Deutschland sozialversicherungspflichtig Beschäftigte 1980 Nordrhein Westfalen Zeitreihe

content.text: {"items":[{"title":"Social Insurance-Contributing Employees in North Rhine-Westphalia, 1980–1989 (Bundestag Historical Employment Statistics)","url_or_doi":"https://dserver.bundestag.de/btd/11/067/1106756.pdf","justification":"Highly relevant historical dataset covering the entire 1980–1989 period. Table 3 provides annual employment figures for North Rhine-Westphalia as of June each year, disaggregated by gender (men, women, and total). Data originate from the German Federal Employment Agency (Bundesanstalt für Arbeit). Particularly useful for examining employment trends and gender differences throughout the 1980s."},{"title":"Federal Employment Agency – Historical Employment Statistics by Federal State (Quarterly Time Series)","url_or_doi":"https://statistik.arbeitsagentur.de/SiteGlobals/Forms/Suche/Einzelheftsuche/Einzelheftsuche_Formular.html?nn=25550&topic_f=sozbe-zr-svb-74","justification":"Official German Federal Employment Agency dataset providing historical quarterly employment statistics by federal state, including North Rhine-Westphalia. Contains information about employees subject to social security contributions, disaggregated by selected characteristics. Particularly relevant for investigating employment developments during the 1980s. Historical coverage should be checked in the available files."},{"title":"Social Insurance-Contributing Employees in North Rhine-Westphalia, June 1980 – Structural Employment Statistics","url_or_doi":"https://www.econbiz.de/Record/sozialversicherungspflichtig-besch%C3%A4ftigte-in-nordrhein-westfalen-gesamt%C3%BCbersicht/10000458006","justification":"Bibliographic record for an official historical statistical publication covering employment in North Rhine-Westphalia during 1980–1982. The publication focuses on employees subject to social security contributions and provides a useful source for examining employment structures in the early 1980s. Access to the underlying historical publication may require consultation of a library or archive."},{"title":"Federal Employment Agency – Employment Statistics by Occupation and Federal State","url_or_doi":"https://statistik.arbeitsagentur.de/DE/Navigation/Statistiken/Fachstatistiken/Beschaeftigung/Beschaeftigte/Beschaeftigte-Nav.html","justification":"Official employment statistics portal containing historical employment time series, including quarterly employment by occupation using the German Classification of Occupations 1988 (Klassifikation der Berufe 1988). Provides a potential source for analyzing employment composition in North Rhine-Westphalia by occupation. The availability of observations specifically from 1980–1989 must be verified."},{"title":"Employment Development in North Rhine-Westphalia, 1976–1998 – Institute for Work and Technology","url_or_doi":"https://www.iat.eu/aktuell/veroeff/ie/nordhaus00e.pdf","justification":"Historical research publication containing statistical tables on employment developments in North Rhine-Westphalia between 1976 and 1998, including every year of the 1980s. Data distinguish the Ruhr region from the rest of North Rhine-Westphalia and provide employment indicators by economic sector, including manufacturing, trade, transportation, and services. Particularly useful for analyzing regional employment restructuring and industrial decline during the 1980s. The tables include relative employment indicators rather than exclusively absolute employment counts."},{"title":"North Rhine-Westphalia Employment Statistics, June 30, 1980 – Statistical Office of NRW","url_or_doi":"https://www.statistischebibliothek.de/mir/servlets/MCRFileNodeServlet/NWHeft_derivate_00014905/A659%20198042_A.pdf","justification":"Digitized original statistical report published by the State Office for Data Processing and Statistics of North Rhine-Westphalia in April 1981. Contains structural data on employees subject to social security contributions as of June 30, 1980. Provides an authoritative primary source for employment conditions at the beginning of the decade and can support detailed historical comparisons."},{"title":"North Rhine-Westphalia Employment and Unemployment Statistics, 1984–1993 – State Occupational Health Reporting","url_or_doi":"https://lia.nrw.de/_media/pdf/service/Publikationen/archiv/alt/gesundheitberichtedaten/Statusanalyse_94_95.pdf","justification":"Historical statistical publication containing labor-market indicators for North Rhine-Westphalia, including unemployment rates for 1984–1993 and employment figures by economic sector for 1987–1993. Useful for studying employment conditions during the second half of the 1980s and examining changes across industries. It also provides contextual unemployment data that complement employment statistics."},{"title":"Federal Employment Agency – Establishments and Employees Subject to Social Insurance Contributions","url_or_doi":"https://statistik.arbeitsagentur.de/SiteGlobals/Forms/Suche/Einzelheftsuche/Einzelheftsuche_Formular.html?nn=32862&topic_f=beschaeftigung-sozbe-bstbetr-heft","justification":"Official statistical publication series documenting establishments and employees subject to social security contributions across Germany, including North Rhine-Westphalia. Data include employment by workplace location, establishment size, and economic sector. Useful for investigating regional employment structures, although the availability of archived editions covering the 1980s requires verification."}]}
